package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

type Other struct{}

var _ = models.ArticleUpdateFields(orm.NewStringField[Other](ir.Field{
	Name: "title", Column: "title", Kind: ir.FieldChar,
}))
